activity_summary: Heminges named your share as forty shillings, against eight-and-twenty last Saturday, and called it the spring's best. You said the chest was not counted. James said nobody was to spend the sheet on the lease, and he did not price a beam. You said nothing was agreed on Monday and that you were not agreeing it now. Heminges said the sheet is the share, not the lease. Nothing of Allen was written on it. Kemp took the same forty and no extra for the dancing.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Named forty, refused the lease a place on the sheet, and shut the book.

entities.name: James Burbage
entities.context: Gave the doors as the cause, and would not price a beam.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Took forty, and would not average it with last Saturday.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Took it as the spring's best, and kept the boys off the sheet.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Took the same forty, and asked no second head for the dancing.

entities.name: George Bryan
entities.context: Took the coin, and would not wait on a beam.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said forty back, left the chest uncounted, and kept Allen off the sheet.

quotes.speaker: james_burbage
quotes.text: Nobody is to spend this sheet on the lease
